summary: Iter31 verification of the reported end-of-scene rehearsal crash + full regression suite. FIX VERIFIED. Playwright drove a 2-line SARAH/MIKE rehearsal on /rehearsal/{id} through 'Start Scene' → 'Done' → completion: 'Scene Complete!' rendered with Accuracy: 100% • Avg. Response: 3.1s, ZERO page errors, ZERO unhandled promise rejections. All 11 required diagnostic markers appeared in the correct order in console (final-line-complete → rehearsal-finish-start → audio-cleanup-start → audio-cleanup-success → speech-cleanup-start → speech-cleanup-success → stats-calculation-start → stats-calculation-success → stats-navigation-start → stats-navigation-success → rehearsal-finish-complete). 'Run Again' cleanly reset the scene to Ready-to-Rehearse (state=idle), proving guard reset. Backend regressions: 4/4 pytest passing (extraction-only contract on /api/scripts/upload and /api/scripts/upload-base64 — no 'id' field, no scripts row persisted; paste flow POST /api/scripts + PUT user_character correctly sets is_user_character=true; QA_UNLIMITED_REHEARSALS=true bypass returns 200 for rehearsals_today=5 free user). Production limit reverse-test: temporarily flipped QA_UNLIMITED_REHEARSALS=false + restarted backend → same 6th rehearsal returned HTTP 403 with exact production message 'You've used all 5 rehearsals for today. Upgrade to Premium for unlimited rehearsals!'. Env restored to QA_UNLIMITED_REHEARSALS=true and backend restarted. Build markers verified via grep: BUILD_ID='1110-QA' (apiConfig.ts:18), BUILD_FINGERPRINT='SM8-1110-QA' (diagnosticsService.ts:12 + _layout.tsx:23), BUILD_PROOF.build=1110. Bug report structure verified via code inspection: BUILD/DEVICE/TIME/NAVIGATION/OPERATION/API/IMPORT/ERROR/RECENT LOG/NATIVE CRASH sections all present in generateChatGPTReport; stripSensitiveDeep applied to metadata to prevent credential leakage; fingerprint SM8-1110-QA emitted in report body.
critical_code_review_comments: Diagnostic banner spam ('SCRIPTM8 API CONFIG', 'CORRECT_DOMAIN: NO', build fingerprint prints) fires on every page load — cosmetic, gate behind __DEV__ or a debug flag.

console.error '[Rehearsal] Speech error: Error' appears during web playback due to expo-speech synthesis error on RN-Web after native SR module init — it is caught by the outer try/catch and does NOT prevent finalization; consider downgrading to warn on web to reduce noise.
Start Scene / Done / Run Again buttons have no testID/data-testid attributes on rehearsal/[id].tsx — Playwright had to fall back to text selectors. Adding testIDs would make automation more robust.

The idempotency 'finalize skipped (already ran)' marker was not exercised in the driven flow (only reachable via re-entry of same instance which doesn't happen with the fire-and-forget guard). Guard logic verified by code inspection at lines 646-653.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (end-to-end rehearsal completes, all 11 markers, Scene Complete UI valid, Run Again resets)

test_credentials: device_id=TEST_iter31_playwright (transient); other tests generate per-run uuid device_ids.
seed_data_creation: One script + rehearsal seeded via API for Playwright drive-through (title=TEST_iter31_pw). pytest fixtures create/tear down TEST_-prefixed scripts, rehearsals, and users automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: End-of-scene crash fix is verified and stable. QA_UNLIMITED_REHEARSALS=true is currently set in backend/.env (as required for further QA). For next iteration if diagnostic markers need to be persisted-to-AsyncStorage verification, run on native (iOS/Android) since web AsyncStorage uses localStorage wrapper. Extraction endpoints contract (no 'id', no persistence) is now covered by test_iteration31_rehearsal_crash_regression.py — keep this file as regression baseline.
rca of the issue: Original crash was in the end-of-scene → finalization → stats transition. Fix (already applied by main agent, verified here): finalizeRehearsal() at rehearsal/[id].tsx:647 now wraps all 4 finalization steps (audio-cleanup, speech-cleanup, stats-calculation, stats-navigation) in individual try/catch, uses Promise.resolve(Speech.stop()).catch() to swallow native rejections, and is guarded by finalizeGuardRef to ensure idempotency. advanceToNextLine at line 721 no longer setState('finished') directly — it dispatches finalizeRehearsal('end-of-scene') and swallows any thrown promise. getStats() at line 947 now hardened with Array.isArray + Number.isFinite fallbacks. Finished UI at line 1170 uses Number.isFinite guards on stats.accuracy and stats.avgHesitation before rendering. Result: rehearsal reaches Scene Complete without crash on web bundle.
